arguments.Title: 운송 예약 중 목적지 변경 차단 검증
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using System; using System.Reflection; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { var go=new GameObject("Reservation guard verification"); try { var client=go.AddComponent<UnityAutonomousClient>(); var flags=BindingFlags.Instance|BindingFlags.NonPublic; var latest=typeof(UnityAutonomousClient).GetField("latest",flags); latest.SetValue(client,JsonUtility.FromJson("{\"transport_phase\":\"PICKUP_SERVICE\"}",latest.FieldType)); client.StartMission("main_gate_road_candidate"); bool waiting=(bool)typeof(UnityAutonomousClient).GetField("waitingForMissionAck",flags).GetValue(client); int pending=(int)typeof(UnityAutonomousClient).GetField("pendingMissions",flags).GetValue(client); if(!client.TransportReserved || waiting || pending!=0 || string.IsNullOrEmpty(client.MissionResult)) throw new Exception("Reservation guard failed"); result.Log("PASS reserved="+client.TransportReserved+" waiting="+waiting+" pending="+pending+" result="+client.MissionResult); } finally { UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(go); } } }
